correctness.rationale: PASS: On very general quartic Pic(X)=ZH+ZL with H.L=1,L²=-2. For D=kH+mL with 1<=k<=2m-1, negative D.L repeatedly forces r=m-floor(k/2) copies of L. Residual B=kH+floor(k/2)L has B.L=k-2floor(k/2) in {0,1} and B.(H-L)=3(k+floor(k/2))>0, so Kleppe criterion quoted by Castorena–Vite Lemma 2.2 ensures smooth irreducible general A. Even k gives disjoint A,L; odd gives one transverse reduced point. In local parameters with L:u=0 and A:v=0, intrinsic Fitting Jacobian ideal from F=u^r (even) is (u^(r-1)) and from F=u^r v (odd) is u^(r-1)(u,v); quotient has length one for r>=2, and for r=1 records isolated node. Independently checked derivative algebra for r=1..11 and parameter parity; analytic proof covers all integers.
